title: MAN TGS Bullbar Polished Custom Built Aluminium Bullbar #14
description: MAN TGS Road Train Polished Aluminium Bullbar, two post box uprights & contoured heavy duty outer pipes with heavy duty high tensile one piece aluminium main cross pipe, no but welds. Light bar brackets to customer specification. Heavy duty backing plate with tow hitch. Provision for lower mudflaps. Fully recessed factory fitted lights protected by the heavy duty polished main channel. Extra Heavy duty backing plate with 38mm tow pin to handle heavy loading.
